## Summary

Describe the problem and the change.

## Related issue or backlog item

Link the issue or backlog ID.

## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Security
- [ ] Release or operations

## User-visible impact

Describe what users will notice. Write "none" if not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] Scope is focused and linked to an issue or backlog item.
- [ ] Tests are added or updated.
- [ ] PHPUnit passes (or "not applicable yet" while the target application does not exist).
- [ ] PHPStan passes without new unreviewed ignores (same exception).
- [ ] PHP-CS-Fixer reports no changes (same exception).
- [ ] Migrations are reversible and tested, if applicable.
- [ ] Authorization and branch scoping are reviewed, including customer/vehicle scope, if applicable.
- [ ] External URLs use public IDs; internal IDs are not exposed, if applicable.
- [ ] Money, stock, and invoice logic are server-side, if applicable.
- [ ] Mechanic mobile is checked on Android Chrome, if applicable.
- [ ] CSRF and output escaping are reviewed, if applicable.
- [ ] UI follows DESIGN.md, if applicable.
- [ ] Translations are added for `en` and `id`, if applicable.
- [ ] Documentation or ADR is updated, if applicable.
- [ ] Changelog is updated for user-visible changes.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, customer data, or debug output are included.

## Screenshots

Add screenshots for UI changes.

## Security notes

Describe any security implications for authentication, authorization, money,
stock, imports, or backups.

## Migration and upgrade notes

Describe schema changes, data migrations, and upgrade steps.
